description: This file defines functions, classes, and utilities for efficient string concatenation and appending in C++, including the AlphaNum class for parameter handling, and functions like StrCat and StrAppend. It also includes definitions for formatting types like Hex and Dec, and internal utilities for string conversion.

classes.name: AlphaNum
classes.description: A class representing an efficient, flexible parameter type for string concatenation functions, capable of converting various data types into string views.

classes.name: Hex
classes.description: A structure for formatting hexadecimal string representations with configurable width and fill character.

classes.name: Dec
classes.description: A structure for formatting decimal string representations with configurable width, fill, and sign handling.

classes.name: AlphaNumBuffer
classes.description: A utility template struct for holding a fixed-size character buffer and its size, used for internal string conversion without memory allocation.

methods.name: StrCat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple string or numeric parameters into a single string without delimiters.

methods.name: StrAppend
methods.description: Appends multiple string or numeric parameters to an existing string efficiently.
